title: Typo-tolerant recall
acceptance: Recall finds a fact despite a small typo in the request or fact; exact matches rank first
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise.
